headline: Banco de la Republica Releases October 2026 Monetary Policy Report
summary: Colombia's central bank delivered its quarterly Monetary Policy Report, providing macroeconomic projections and reviewing inflation trajectories.
why: Banco de la Republica's policy reports outline the central bank's forecast for inflation and interest rates, influencing sovereign yields and the Colombian peso.

impacts.name: Colombia Policy Rate
